canvas.background: near-black green-tinted screen #0A0F0A with faint scanlines
canvas.composition: boxed output panels + prompt-driven lists, mono labels

color_palette.secondary: dim phosphor #5A825A for chrome and scanlines
color_palette.rule: one phosphor accent; amber #FFB000 / ice #5AC8FF / alert #FF5A5A only for status (warn / info / error)

typography.title: monospace everywhere (Consolas / 等宽) — headings included, block-cursor accent
typography.body: monospace console body (Consolas / 等宽), prompt-bulleted lists
typography.labels: mono panel labels and folios (Consolas / 等宽)
typography.text_quality: phosphor-on-black is high-contrast by design; keep it legible

layout_patterns: boxed output panel: console frame with mono title bar carrying content blocks
prompt list: bullets are > / $ prompt glyphs, one command per line
status accent row: amber / ice / red reserved for warn / info / error markers
cover = full-bleed terminal frame + large phosphor prompt line + blinking-cursor motif
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Mono for EVERY run including headings — a proportional face anywhere breaks the register.
negative_prompt: no proportional typeface anywhere — mono for every run
no second decorative accent beyond status colours
no skeuomorphic glass or gradient UI

visual_elements.allowed: scanlines, prompt glyphs, boxed panels, block cursors, status dots
visual_elements.avoid: proportional fonts, gradients, photos, rounded soft cards

rendering_constraints: Retro CRT terminal look, phosphor on black, scanlines.
Fixed-width register everywhere, status colours only for state.
